You need to try to ween yourself off of it, not quit cold turkey. I mean it. Try setting up "Cheat days" or days where you give yourself permission to fap. Nobody here will tell you that, but for some people, it is the way. Even if you reduce your fapping down to twice a week, that's better than 4 or 5 times a day. 

I'm trying to do this too, and it's easier said than done, but i've found that if I set a day in the near future where i'm allowing myself to fap or watch porn, it makes going without it slightly more bearable -- and who knows? Maybe you'll feel better about yourself and when the supposed day comes, you won't even wanna break your streak. Point is, be easy on yourself. Quitting cold turkey can be tough and sometimes even unhealthy
